Proven to improve educational outcomes at scale.

Efekta Education delivers real learning outcomes, not just engagement. Our technology has been proven to significantly improve learning outcomes, even when measured across thousands of teachers and millions of students.

The assistance every teacher deserves.

Efekta’s Agentic Teaching Platform supports teachers and gives every student a truly personal learning journey — answering questions, recommending practice, and keeping them on the fastest path to success. Classroom teachers save time by automating repetitive tasks, and are freed up to to do what only they can do: inspire, motivate, and give their time to the students who need it most.

Teach skills, not just knowledge.

Our AI-powered curriculum delivers a structured, hands-on learning experience that goes beyond memorization. Students build practical abilities across subjects — from mastering English communication to tackling STEM challenges that mirror the real world. They might role-play conversations with AI characters, solve interactive math and science problems, or receive instant feedback on writing tasks. They don’t just learn — they learn to apply their skills with confidence.

Classroom AI gives teachers a clear picture of every learner’s journey — who’s thriving, who needs extra support, and which topics the whole class could revisit. Actionable insights.

With Addi, our AI learning companion, every student finishes a lesson knowing exactly how they did. After each session, Addi provides personalized, actionable feedback — highlighting what the student did well, where they made progress, and the specific areas they can focus on next. Instead of generic comments, students get clear guidance they can use immediately to improve. This makes learning more motivating because they see their strengths recognized and always know the next step forward. 

Learn in Efekta Class™ with Addi.

Addi now teaches inside our award-winning Efekta Class™ — an immersive virtual classroom that brings learning to life. Blending live interaction with realistic scenarios and simulations, Efekta Class™ keeps students actively involved. With Addi guiding each step, learners get instant feedback, recognition, and clear next steps — making learning more engaging, personal, and connected to the real world.

Our systems are designed with data minimization and user protection at their core, upholding the highest standards of security and privacy. Privacy Preference Center

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
More Information

Manage Consent Preferences

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Functional Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
